questions.prompt: Which SQL statement retrieves all columns from the 'employees' table?
questions.explanation: SELECT * selects all columns from the specified table.

questions.prompt: Which statement returns rows where salary > 50000?

options.text: SELECT * FROM employees GROUP BY salary > 50000;
SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY salary > 50000;

questions.explanation: WHERE filters rows before any aggregation occurs.

questions.prompt: To find the average salary per department, which query is correct?

options.text: SELECT department, AVG(salary) FROM employees GROUP BY department;
SELECT department, AVG(salary) FROM employees ORDER BY department;
SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees GROUP BY department;
SELECT department, salary FROM employees GROUP BY department;

questions.explanation: Both department and AVG(salary) must appear in SELECT and GROUP BY.
